constraints_found.constraint: Craving: sushi (cold food, too hot for anything warm)
constraints_found.source_line: script[2] roxy: "SUSHI. way too hot out for anything warm. let's do it!!"
script[5] maya: "sushi yes. fancy sushi no. one dollar sign max, the trip fund is non-negotiable"
script[8] cyrus: "Sushi works for me. One rule, as always: I'm allergic to peanuts..."

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian, needs proper vegetarian rolls, not just sides (strict diet, deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: script[11] maya: "mina. you're vegetarian. rice and edamame is a side, not a lunch"; reinforced by script[12] cyrus and script[13] mina: "a few veggie rolls to choose from would be really nice"

constraints_found.constraint: Dairy intolerance: nothing creamy, no cream cheese (costs a star)
constraints_found.source_line: script[14] roxy: "nothing creamy in mine pls. dairy and i don't get along"; reinforced by script[17] cyrus: "Some rolls have cream cheese in them"

venue_evaluation.downtown_koi_counter: Sushi, $, no peanuts, full meat-free roll section, no milk/cream/cream cheese. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_evaluation.downtown_kumo_bar: Peanuts on rolls and peanut sauce with every set. Allergy deal-breaker: 0 stars.
venue_evaluation.downtown_silver_reed: Fish in every roll, nothing vegetarian. Diet deal-breaker: 0 stars.
venue_evaluation.downtown_hinoki_table: Cream cheese and creamy mayo on nearly everything, including veggie rolls. Dairy intolerance costs a star: 2 stars.
venue_evaluation.downtown_cedar_line: $$, one tier over budget, costs a star: 2 stars.

notes: Fair and consistent. Every constraint is stated plainly, and Cyrus repeats both the peanut and cream-cheese warnings, so nothing is hidden. The vegetarian clue is the most subtle part: Mina downplays it ('i'm easy'), but Maya states it outright straight away. Each decoy breaks exactly one constraint (peanut, vegetarian, dairy, price), which makes a nice elimination puzzle. It may be a little easy, because the reviews name each constraint almost word for word (Koi Counter's second review mentions an 'allergic coworker and lactose-intolerant intern'). Two small things: the 'too hot for anything warm' remark could hint at a cold-food preference, but every venue is sushi so it doesn't change the pick. The miso soup with fish stock note at Silver Reed is a nice extra detail. Nothing unfair or contradictory.
